scope: Read-only native x86-64 ELF inspection of frozen ordinary release binaries; actual CLI edges and sorting pointer flow. No target execution.
limits: Assertions bind actual CLI direct calls and concrete sorting pointer arguments, not only symbol names.
Candidate has uniqueness checks at completed-group and final writes, plus conditional copy fallbacks.
Sorting scratch, parsed input arrays and retained capacity remain. This is not a dynamic allocation measurement or a throughput result.
Generic fallback implementations remain in the binary; these conclusions apply to the inspected concrete Array CLI path.
